summary: SeeQC, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting the mutual termination of its Agreement and Plan of Merger with Allegro Merger Corp., effective August 25, 2026, prior to the October 31, 2026 outside date. Under the Termination Agreement, if SeeQC consummates a Trigger Event (certain equity financing or business combination), it will pay Allegro up to $2 million in documented third-party expenses and issue shares equal to $6 million based on a $1.3 billion pre-money valuation. Claims were released, with certain exceptions and Allegro indemnification obligations. What to watch: SeeQC's pursuit of an alternative transaction before the outside date.
